role: The Nether and End population features: WorldGenHellLava (open and hidden springs, with the immediate liquid update tick), WorldGenFire, WorldGenGlowStone1/2 (one shared body), WorldGenFlowers with Nether mushrooms, the quartz vein over netherrack, and WorldGenSpikes with its ender crystal reported through spike_crystal_last.

structs.name: NETHER_ROWS
structs.java: the rows FeatureProbeNether appends to the oracle's FeatureProbe table (helllava, fire, glowstone1, glowstone2, nethermushrooms x2, quartz, helllavahidden, spikes)

gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
lines 109-111, function feature_helllava: toggles the global ticks_set_immediate flag around liquid_update_tick (World.scheduledUpdatesAreImmediate)
lines 274-299, function features_nether_for: string-compare lookup table
notes: populate_nether.c drives these for real chunk population; serverreplay.c spawns the reported crystal through endfight_spawn_crystal. The y bands mirror ChunkProviderHell.populate's draws as the probe makes them. The End spike placement loop itself (BiomeEndDecorator) is not in this file.
